entries.description:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes
Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.
Runic Outburst
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Runic Chain Whip
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Runic Soliskin
Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name
When Full Stop reaches 100, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Innate Gift?
Sigrika can hold up to 2 of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.
Rune
Sigrika holds up to 4. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional.
Hitting a target directly with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target directly with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Answer.
Full Stop
After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 of Full Stop, up to 100 points.
Soliskin Vitality
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.
